wayback._eras_pending: 20vc.fund exists only from 2024-09 (the Framer site; the Internet Archive's CDX for 20vc.fund/* starts 2024-09-13). The firm's earlier list is the WordPress portfolio post type on the podcast site, thetwentyminutevc.com/portfolio/<slug>/, 2022-2024, read from Common Crawl (the Internet Archive was under a machine-wide block from 19:36 UTC, doubled to two hours at 20:36): scratch/cc-cluster.py (static index) -> scratch/cc-fetch.py -> scratch/cc-parse.py -> sources/wayback/parsed/<year>.json. 'stealth' is a placeholder card that names no company (T5) and is configured out.

roster._note: The roster is curated at kickoff (sources/wayback/partner-roster.json) from the Companies House member register of Twenty VC LLP OC435791 (exact appointment dates for every member since 2021-03-02), the adviser's Form ADV Schedule A (CRD 316359), the firm's own Form D related persons, the live team page (sources/site/team-cards.json) and dated press for the joiners. The live team page is one page with no per-person URLs; the CDX sweep is re-run when the archive answers and may only extend a register-dated window. The operator partners of the 20Growth, 20Sales and 20Product funds are NOT roster: each card names the partner's own employer (Dropbox, Vanta, Ramp...), and sweeping those names through Form D would confirm their employers' own filings (COLLECTION.md s5, the First Round founder-directory trap).

site_api._note: 20vc.fund is a Framer site (escalation ladder step 4). /portfolio server-renders 16 cards behind a client-side Load More; the whole collection (79 items on 2026-09-28) ships as a Framer CMS data chunk, decoded by scratch/framercms.py into sources/site/companies-framer.json (scratch/site-from-framer.py rebuilds it, --fetch re-downloads the chunk). The card carries a name, a one-liner, two sector enums, the company URL and an Exit flag: no round word and no investment year, so the site is a listing layer only and sets no entry stage. /team renders every card server-side. Kitty Mayo is Project Europe's CEO, a separate fund (decisions.md D5), so she carries no bucket and does not publish on the profile; the three operator-partner groups are left unmapped for the same reason (their own funds' advisers, not the firm's team).
